def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    # Ensure no negative remaining capacity (item doesn't fit)
    remaining = np.maximum(remaining, 0)
    # Avoid division by zero; if bin is empty, assign max priority
    valid_bins = bins > 0
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins, dtype=float)
    # For bins with positive capacity, compute priority based on how full they are after adding item
    # Higher priority for bins with smaller remaining capacity (closer to full)
    non_empty_mask = bins > 0
    if np.any(non_empty_mask):
        # Normalize remaining capacity by bin size
        normalized_remaining = remaining[non_empty_mask] / bins[non_empty_mask]
        # Invert to make closer-to-full bins more prioritized
        priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = 1 - normalized_remaining
        # Clamp values to [0, 1]
        priority_scores[non_empty_mask] = np.clip(priority_scores[non_empty_mask], 0, 1)
    return priority_scores
